coverageNote: Draft. Built from the exam breakdown of the 309A exam: the tasks mapped here (B-7, B-8, B-9, B-11, C-16, C-17, D-22, D-24) account for 48 of the 100 questions (task numbers, titles and counts were checked against the occupational standard in the pre-review). The app can teach about 24 questions' worth of that so far under the CEC. The task-to-skill mapping is an estimate to be confirmed by a credential expert; the C-17 mapping is the least certain. Skills marked deferred have no Practitioner-level CEC content yet.
